fact: The health ministry's monitoring plan for the PNDS 2023-2027, validated on 6 October 2023, requires each health facility to key its validated monthly or quarterly report (RMA/RTA) into DHIS2 before the 5th of the following month, names care providers at the USP, CHP, CHR and CHU as those entering data, and gives the SNIS completeness rate, defined as facilities having entered a complete SNIS report in DHIS2 over all facilities due to enter one, as 96.5% (2021).
title: Plan de suivi et évaluation du Plan national de développement sanitaire 2023-2027
publisher: Ministère de la Santé et de l'Hygiène Publique
